title: White label for agencies & brands
description: White-label leather accessories for agencies and brands, from your design direction to an agreed production specification.

body.html: White-label leather accessories for agencies and brands, from your design direction to an agreed production specification.

media.alt: Design study of a cognac leather luggage tag with a buckle and privacy window

body.html: A moodboard, sketch or existing accessory can provide the starting point. We work through materials, dimensions, fittings and branding with you. Roles are agreed early: who leads the design, who consolidates feedback and who approves the specification?

We support agencies with product development and execution. Contacts, presentation and review routes are aligned with the working relationship. Confidentiality and labelling requirements belong in the initial brief.

Material samples, artwork and the agreed sampling process make your idea reviewable. After approval, the agreed specification is handmade in the EU. Whether you need a one-off for a special occasion, a very small run or a substantial brand commission, we plan the scope with you and consider future additions.
Bespoke genuine-leather luggage tags for BMW Group Classic Events. Realised by SFP in collaboration with the appointed agency, Metzler+Vater.
